newsitem.title: USA: Jillian's to merge with J.W. Childs.
newsitem.headline: Jillian's to merge with J.W. Childs.

text.p: Jillian's Entertainment Corp, an owner and operator of billiards clubs, and J.W. Childs Equity Partners, an investment firm, have agreed to a merger that would give Jillian's shareholders $0.50 a share.
Seven shareholders who each will have an ongoing relationship with the company will not take part in this deal, Jillian's and J.W. Childs said in a joint statement.

The merger is expected to be completed in July 1997, subject to approval by Jillian's shareholders. The board of directors has approved the merger and shareholders holding 44 percent of Jillian's common stock have agreed to vote in favor of the deal, the company said.
Jillian's currently owns or partially owns, operates and manages 10 upscale billiard clubs throughout the United States.
